chapter: 三年级上册 Unit 1 Making friends
title: My New Friend
content: Hello! My name is Amy. I am six years old. I have a new friend. His name is Sam. He is six too. We are in the same class. We play together after school.

chapter: 七年级上册 Starter Unit 1 Hello!
title: A Nice Morning
content: Good morning, class! I am Miss Wang, your English teacher. I am from Beijing. I am kind and friendly. I like reading books and playing sports. Let's be good friends!
